_README: Hand-curated provenance for the model files no workflow note documents,
and corrections for notes that are wrong. Read by harvest.cjs, which
prefers a URL found in the workflows' own notes over anything here, so a
plain entry only ever fills gaps.
url    a DIRECT download. Only ever put one here that has been checked to
resolve (verify.cjs does that) -- a wrong direct link silently
downloads the wrong weights.
source a page for a human: the repo or project the file comes from.
auto   true when a node pack or pipeline fetches this itself. Such an
entry must never be reported as a missing model, and nothing
should offer to download it.
note   why it is like that, in a sentence a person can act on. harvest
copies it into every meta that declares the file.
_why   for whoever edits this file; harvest ignores it.
override  true makes this entry beat a link found in the notes. For a
note that is demonstrably wrong, or for a link fixed by hand in
the metas: without an override the next harvest --write puts
the note's link back. The notes index keeps the FIRST link it
finds for a filename, in folder order, so one bundle's note can
speak for every bundle that uses the same file.
Files that are genuinely unknown are LEFT OUT on purpose, so the harvest
keeps reporting them. A guess here would be worse than the gap. None is
left out today (2026-11-05): every declared model has a url, a source or
auto. A hand fix to a meta's url/source/note must be copied here as an
override, or harvest.cjs --check (and the next --write) will undo it.

qwen-image-2.1-fix-1.0-comfy.safetensors.note: The author's recommended sampler settings are only inside the workflow zip in this repo, not in the README.

Qwen-Image-Edit-Unblur-Upscale_20.safete.note: Four training checkpoints (_5/_10/_15/_20) live in this repo; the bundle exposes them through a dropdown.

Qwen-Image-2.1-Fun-Controlnet-Union.safe.note: ComfyUI core cannot load this file -- it needs the ComfyUI-QwenImage21-FunControlNet pack, which is why that pack exists.

flux2_klein_9b_refcontrol_depth.safetens.note: From the adapter author's own repo (thedeoxen). Comfy-Org's FLUX.2 Klein repack does not hold this file.

pid_1.5_qwenimage_1024_to_4096_4step_bf1.note: Comfy-Org's PixelDiT repack. Running it also needs the ComfyUI-Latent-Tiled-PiD node pack, which is installed separately.

gemma_2_2b_it_elm_bf16.safetensors.note: Ships with the PiD 1.5 release; it is PiD's own prompt encoder, not a general Gemma build.

flux2-vae.safetensors._why: The TripoSplat template's note links VAST-AI/TripoSplat's copy, and that bundle's folder sorts first, so without this every FLUX.2 / FLUX.3 / Ideogram card got the TripoSplat link (fixed by hand on 2026-11-04).

qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors._why: The first note that names this file links the Hunyuan-Video-1.5 repack. The Qwen-Image repack is this text encoder's own home.

Krea2_Turbo_convrot_int8mixed.safetensor._why: The int8 build is Winnougan's, not Comfy-Org's. The model audit's redownload column named Comfy-Org/Krea-2 until 2026-11-05, and without this a run with MODEL_AUDIT_CSV set gave the card a Winnougan url and a Comfy-Org source. Kept because it carries the direct url.

krea2_realism_lora.safetensors._why: Set by hand on 2026-11-04 to the LoRA author's own repo. The model audit's redownload column named Comfy-Org/Krea-2 until 2026-11-05. Kept because it carries the direct url.

qwen_image_2512_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors._why: Comfy-Org renamed Qwen-Image_ComfyUI to Qwen-Image (followed on 2026-11-04). The model audit's redownload column named the old repo, which only works through a redirect, until 2026-11-05. Kept because it carries the direct url.

qwen_image_edit_2511_bf16.safetensors._why: Comfy-Org renamed Qwen-Image-Edit_ComfyUI to Qwen-Image-Edit (followed on 2026-11-04); the model audit's redownload column named the old repo until 2026-11-05. Source only: no direct link has been checked for this file, and an override with no url removes any url a note would supply.

moss_image_color_depth_control.safetenso._why: The download is Comfy-Org's repack; the page for a human is the LoRA author's own repo.

yolox_l.torchscript.pt.note: Fetched by comfyui_controlnet_aux into its own ckpts/ folder, not models/. Use the TorchScript build, not the .onnx one -- this rig's onnxruntime is CPU-only, which makes DWPose 12x slower.

dw-ll_ucoco_384_bs5.torchscript.pt.note: Fetched by comfyui_controlnet_aux into its own ckpts/ folder, not models/.

seedvr2_ema_3b_fp16.safetensors.note: Downloaded by the seedvr2_videoupscaler pack into models/SEEDVR2/.

seedvr2_ema_7b_sharp_fp16.safetensors.note: Downloaded by the seedvr2_videoupscaler pack into models/SEEDVR2/.

ema_vae_fp16.safetensors.note: SeedVR2's VAE, downloaded by the pack into models/SEEDVR2/.

microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B.note: A HuggingFace repo the pipeline stages through, not a file in models/. About 17 GB on disk.

facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m.note: Staged by the TRELLIS.2 pipeline; gated on HuggingFace, so it needs an accepted licence and a token.

Pixal3D/TencentARC_Pixal3D.note: A HuggingFace repo the Pixal3D pack stages through, not a file in models/. About 23 GB on disk.

Pixal3D/camenduru_dinov3-vitl16-pretrain.note: An ungated mirror of facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m, staged by the Pixal3D pack.

Pixal3D/briaai_RMBG-2.0.note: Background removal, staged by the Pixal3D pack. Non-commercial licence.

LivePortrait (auto-downloaded by (Down)L.note: The LivePortraitKJ pack downloads these on first use; no filename is named in the graph, so nothing here can be checked against the disk.

InsightFace + MediaPipe face croppers (a.note: Face detectors the LivePortrait cropper fetches itself. Only the MediaPipe cropper is wired in this bundle.

ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-pixel-spatial-upscal.note: Lightricks' Pixel Spatial Upscaler adapter, and NOT the DEBLUR-trigger LoRA its template's note links to: that repo (LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Deblur) only holds ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-deblur-0.9. Gated, so a token is needed.
